notes.title: Announcement of Magic Pussy: Chapter 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43827334/cbcd74efa3b0f5f7ce6e997e48a377efa9ebd29d.jpg[/img]

[h3]First of all, [/h3]We're thrilled to share that the second chapter of Magic Pussy marks a huge leap forward for us. The quality of content we've achieved here far surpasses what was in Magic Pussy 1 and our previous projects. We're truly proud of this and excited to finally announce the next chapter. Now for the details!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43827334/787a109739ae00abb042c150bd9b34b116757490.jpg[/img]

[h3]About the Story. [/h3]The game's events unfold in the same magical university as the first part, but it's been greatly expanded. Old locations have been revamped, some removed, and new floors added where you'll meet new characters. Engage with them in main and side quests, mini-games, and other activities (you know what we mean). Some old characters have been removed from the story, but others will still join in your adventures. Speaking of adventures! Expect a new detective story, full of intrigue, investigations, betrayals, relationships with old characters, and meeting new ones. You'll even attend a magical dance ball, where you can invite your favorite lady!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43827334/9c6feb468df09f9dae09b782af2420dd4e4cb8a9.jpg[/img]

[h3]About the Content.[/h3] As mentioned earlier, the second chapter is a big step forward for us. We've significantly improved animation and graphic quality. There's also much more content: more game days, twice as many characters, double the 18+ scenes, collectible 18+ cards that can be found in a revamped, user-friendly gallery, ten times more plot twists, new hot teachers with new magical items and mini-games that offer special rewards. Plenty of new achievements, including secret ones, various game endings, and even a secret one. Definitely a lot to keep you occupied between 18+ scenes. 🙂

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43827334/762039a6a7b510f0dc5d5be90b66054c308ce1cb.jpg[/img]

[h3]Other Nice Touches.[/h3] No more raw builds. We've rigorously tested to avoid any "Cassandra situations." Everything will work smoothly and bug-free. Also, with the expanded game world, we've improved navigation within it. There's now a magical, stylish, and convenient map showing floor plans from above, character locations, and quest spots. We've also added something like a "bestiary" - a menu section with art, lore, and backstory for each game character. Plus, a cool gallery to track your progress with sex card and animation unlocks. 🙂

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43827334/e0c59a71617281bfd6dc109e69210c39fe83a0b6.jpg[/img]

[h3]About the Dates.[/h3] The release is coming soon. VERY soon, we'll delight you with the new chapter of Magic Pussy. So, you have time to replay (or finish, for those who had the Cassandra issue) the first part.


[h2]Finally, we'd like to explain why we've been quiet for so long.[/h2]

Our company is growing and evolving. We've welcomed new people - modelers, animators, narrative designers, developers. With more people, communication and teamwork become more complex. Unfortunately, we faced communication issues. Many might have thought we were ignoring the community, not fixing bugs, etc. In reality, we read every feedback, took it seriously, and noted your suggestions. We fully revamped the first game a while ago but didn't release it because we wanted to thoroughly test everything and launch the remaster simultaneously with the second chapter. The second part also underwent extensive testing and polishing.

We admit our mistakes with the initial release quality of the first part, the delay in releasing the bug-fixed version, and not updating you while we worked hard, tackled problems, improved our skills, and developed this fantastic new game part. We recognize and accept these errors.
Over this period, we've learned from our mistakes, enhanced our skills, and now we're ready to do more and better. Thank you for your feedback, patience, and anticipation. Today, we release the remaster of the first part, and very soon, the second.

[h3]Enjoy the game![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2512190/Magic_Pussy_Chapter_2/

notes.title: Remaster of Magic Pussy: Chapter 1
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

Today we're excited to bring you not one, but two great pieces of news! For those who prefer a quick summary:

[list]
[*] Cassandra no longer breaks the game, new graphics, bug fixes, improved navigation, rebalanced mini-games, a save system, mini-map, and more.
[*] Announcement of Magic Pussy: Chapter 2. New story, new locations, new appealing characters, twice as many characters and content, including 18+ scenes. Coming very soon and will be ten times better than the first part of the game.
[/list]

For those who don't mind reading more, here are the details:


[h1]Remaster of Magic Pussy: Chapter 1 [/h1]

[h3]Cassandra.[/h3] Ah, Cassandra... She no longer breaks the game. We've rebuilt everything from scratch, fixed bugs, tortured our basement-locked testers, but finally ensured that quests no longer break. Now you can complete all main and side quests and unlock all the content, hooray!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43827334/557addc056a6ed9b9bb95bfb25987eb8ab1a798c.png[/img]

[h3]Graphics.[/h3] Everything in the game is now in 4K60fps (previously FullHD24fps). Locations, character interactions, 18+ content, everything is now smooth and beautiful.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43827334/e2b56944c0a0af44faff823210424d307d66f4bd.jpg[/img]

[h3]Save and load system.[/h3] We've heard your feedback. Now you have slots to save your progress at different stages, and you can save and load anytime, anywhere.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43827334/fc52088e2e5b8c1c584f341a9bd8f4579fb390e2.png[/img]

[h3]We've revamped world navigation.[/h3] Moving around still works the same, click on doors or paths, but now there's a mini-map and visual indicators to make navigation easier.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43827334/a0b239c03e490dec944301d9160650732797c599.png[/img]


Other minor changes like rebalanced mini-games, game economy, gallery, various menus, and more.
Now, let's dive into the most important part.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43827334/8cce9793cf25292ffaa6194656bdd39d523e012a.png[/img]

notes.title: New Language Update: Chinese, Japanese, and Korean Support! 🎮🌏
notes.content:
Greetings, Gamers!

We're absolutely thrilled to announce that our beloved game is expanding its horizons! Starting today, we're rolling out full support for Chinese, Japanese, and Korean languages, bringing our game to millions of new players across Asia!

This update includes:
🌐 Complete localization of in-game text, menus, and subtitles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43827334/df5249f55aa87938de53782814309865c1be7253.jpg[/img]


Thank you for your continued support,
Happy gaming, everyone! 🎉

notes.title: Where the hell is Charlie ?
notes.content:
Greetings, Adventurers! 

We're excited to see that so many of you have embarked on this incredible journey in our game. We've noticed that some of you are experiencing difficulties in completing the very first quest - finding the elusive character, Charlie. Don't worry, we're here to help! Just follow these simple steps and you'll be on your way to becoming a seasoned adventurer. 🗺️

Quest: Finding Charlie 🔍
Objective: Locate and talk to Charlie

Step-by-Step Guide: 🚶‍♂️

1. Head to the Central Courtyard: From your starting point, make your way to the Central Courtyard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43827334/b67f09db4ae81ff200dd3ea455591c084c1eaf06.png[/img]

2. Proceed to the Living Room: From the Central Courtyard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43827334/22134bd649d569d04a60ba84de0a4f33976d9f9b.png[/img]

3. Enter the Men's Room: Continue through the Living Room and look for a door that leads to the Men Room. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43827334/b60bfabbae712e0b74c6a883aeaf00d54c65f0b0.png[/img]

4. Talk to Charlie: Now that you're in the Men Room, you'll find Charlie engaged in a conversation near the bed. Approach him and initiate a dialogue to complete the quest. Charlie is a vital character who will offer valuable information and assistance as you progress through the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43827334/f08f8c14d388dc04a739971a969e260d7a610e99.png[/img]


We hope this guide helps you complete the first quest and find Charlie with ease. Remember, this is just the beginning of a grand adventure, and many more exciting challenges await you. Good luck, and happy gaming! 🎮
